ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: The Picture Book: History, Art, and Visual Literacy] Meets Tu-Fri, May 31-June 3 and Mon-Fri, June 6-10. See section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog. Instructor is Leonard S. Marcus. Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/programs/mbms/certificate1); permission of Marianne Steadley is required to enroll (steadley@illinois.edu). See section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog . Questions about the course can be directed to Christine Jenkins (cajenkin@illinois.edu).
